evidence.observation: 3.3 ppm at start of growth, consistent with purged baseline (~2-6 ppm during ramp)
Rose steadily at every reading to 33.2 ppm, about 10x baseline
Steady ~100 sccm matching setpoint, so less Ar dilution does not explain the O2 rise
Flat ~760 Torr, which argues against exhaust blockage
T holds 750 C with ~46% power, so the thermal system looks normal

args.missing_evidence: A leak check (e.g. isolate the tube and watch for pressure rise, or check the flange/O-ring seals) to confirm air is getting in, and a check that the O2 sensor is not drifting. Reference distributions for the growth stage would also help.
